provenance.notes: AUD-07 C13a corrected rule: every exposure-increasing market order fills at its trigger price adverse-adjusted by the slippage. ATR 1; entry 100.02; DCA levels 99.02 / 98.02 / 97.02, basket stop 95.02; q0 = 10 / (5 + 1.5x4 + 2.25x3 + 3.375x2) = 0.408163, safety order 1 = 0.612245 at 99.02 x 1.0002 = 99.039804. Candle 280 (red) reaches 99.0199 (order 1 only; the basket TP 100.43 is behind the path). Signal exit on the close of 281 at 99.03 x 0.9998. pnl = (xp - avg) x Q - fees = -0.53154 (legacy slip-free add: -0.51941).
